title: Prove the European auxiliary task 360 entry condition
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Trace dispatcher state 37 and command 11 into the original task 360 queue. Record the observed actor selector at the matching dispatcher-state boundaries.
validation: Wine z5naxdzl verifies six original instruction windows and authenticates 345 retained snapshots. Forty-nine gated state-37 boundaries contain selector zero. The cohort has no command-11 entry or states 113 and 114. Wine drained and protected inputs passed.
limitations: An ordinary trace still needs a source-backed command-11 input or later checkpoint. The effective selector writer and live domain, secondary ID 361, integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
